title: Center, Lenses, Living Metabolisms & Repair — Expanded Operational Meaning of #267–271
status: deepening of project-center and lifecycle commits
purpose: Transform the Potato center from an identity node into an orientation-and-return service connecting purpose, embodiment, memory, culture, correction and action.

center_job.not: A claim that all knowledge originates in Potatoverse or that all comparative traditions secretly mean the same thing.
center_job.is: The place where the project states its own questions, values, vocabulary, unresolved tensions and reasons for connecting distant domains.
center_job.return_question: After exploring a source or world-system, what did we learn that changes the project, the reader's orientation, or a concrete research question?

lenses.rule: A lens changes the question, not the owner.
lenses.wheel: Which coordinated functions recur around a hub?
lenses.polarity: Which opposed/complementary variables structure the relation, and are they true binaries?
lenses.memory: What persists, is forgotten, recovered or rewritten?
lenses.culture: How is meaning socially reproduced, contested and transmitted?
lenses.practice: What changes when the concept becomes conduct?

Spirit.job: value, meaning, legitimacy, relation and orientation

Mind.job: perception, interpretation, decision, memory and coordination

Body.job: embodiment, capability, constraint and material action

Culture.job: social reproduction and mutation of meaning

living_metabolisms.synthesis: Spirit/Mind/Body describe aspects of an entity now; History/Culture describe how those aspects persist and change across time and populations.

operator_mechanics.Door: Separate → liminal transition → incorporation. Test admission, transformation, reversibility and who controls credentials.
operator_mechanics.Tree: Differentiate while preserving shared support. Test branch purpose, resource flows, pruning and future Seed.
operator_mechanics.Fruit: Evaluate output, beneficiary, burden, persistence, externality and future capability.
operator_mechanics.Shadow: Search for excluded evidence, unrepresented parties, suppressed costs and model blind spots.
operator_mechanics.Garden: Cultivate capability, diversity, feedback, voice, exit and regenerative future options.
operator_mechanics.Forge: Bounded transformation under pressure, followed by cooling/observation; pain alone is not transformation.
operator_mechanics.Repair: Preserve truth, stop harmful mechanism, restore capability where possible, permit separation/closure where needed.
operator_mechanics.Revision: Allow canon/model change while preserving provenance of prior state.
operator_mechanics.LocalCenter: Scoped organizing focus with explicit jurisdiction; never rival global center.

institutional_application.Mind: Surveillance, expertise, guidelines, governance, information systems.
institutional_application.Body: Staff, laboratories, clinics, money, logistics and supply.
institutional_application.History: Past outbreaks, institutional reforms, prior failures/successes.
institutional_application.Culture: Professional norms, public trust, communication practices.
institutional_application.Garden: Does intervention increase community health capability?
institutional_application.Shadow: Whose data, harms or perspectives are missing?
institutional_application.Revision: Can guidance change transparently as evidence changes?

discovery_questions: Where do Spirit, Mind and Body of an institution diverge?
Which local centers have enough autonomy to correct the whole, and which are merely decorative?
Where is Shadow information systematically blocked from reaching decision systems?
Does repair change recurrence or only narrative?
Does Garden support create future Seed/capability or permanent dependency?
Which historical revision increased accuracy without destroying continuity?
